backlogWorkItems.title: Implement GET /workspaces/:id/notifications route
backlogWorkItems.description: List notifications for the requesting member with unread filtering, cursor pagination, and workspace permission checks.

backlogWorkItems.title: Fix websocket disconnect on workspace switch
backlogWorkItems.description: Switching workspaces drops the realtime socket and the client never resubscribes, so live updates silently stop until refresh. Reproduce by switching twice within five seconds.

backlogWorkItems.title: Add saved view switcher dropdown
backlogWorkItems.description: Dropdown listing personal and shared saved views in separate sections, calling the saved view list route and applying the selected view to the board.

backlogWorkItems.title: Ship notification schema migration
backlogWorkItems.description: Schema migration for notification storage, already deployed.
